remarks: Welcome to 112 East Avenue! A wonderful and spacious 4 Bedroom Townhouse with lovely, private stone front terrace/patio. Set back from the street with 2 designated parking spaces and featuring an oversized eat in kitchen with ample space for meal prep and entertaining with convenient access leading to private patio. Large Living Room, with hardwood floors, featuring oversized window and wood-burning fireplace, leads to an oversized Formal Dining Room with hardwood floors. The family room has direct access to 1/2 bath and sliders leading to the backyard. The upper level offers a huge primary bedroom and private full bath. There are 3 additional bedrooms plus a large full bath with dressing table and oversized shower. Pull down attic AND full basement offer additional storage.

facts.tenantPays: All Utilities,Cable TV,Credit Check,Liability Insurance,Trash Service
